About Us

Is a commercial service company with a legal personality with full financial and administrative independence in carrying out its activities and functions and registered under the law of the Turkish State and specialized in providing consultancy services. The company was established in early 2014 and was based in Istanbul,

Our Mission

We are leading the real estate market by providing the highest standards of quality and design in both residential and specialized properties and to offer our business a framework of innovation, flexibility and creativity.

Our Vision

To be the most distinguished real estate consultant in the region and to offer residential units and real estate with innovative designs that contribute to the formation of the best investment opportunities.

Our Values

Our Services

During the purchase process

Our consultants can guide you through the process of buying property from beginning to end, taking care of all necessary steps and papers, including transfer of title deed (TAPU), opening bank account, obtaining tax number, and coordinating with your lawyer. Our hands will be in your hands to answer all your questions and reassure you of any concerns

After sales service

We ensure the smooth transition of the new property to your possession and your own property with our partners in the after-sales service, which includes supervision of any additions you need in the property from building and other, coordination with utilities to connect water, electricity, internet, telephone and other things.

Real Estate Management

If you want to rent your property, we will find you reliable tenants, with all the guarantees and checks related to the property to ensure that your property will be in the hands of honest. We will act as the contact point for the tenant and you, as well as arrange maintenance, care and supervision of the rental payments, while keeping abreast of any developments in the property or market.

Moving to Turkey

We have a number of experienced consultants who assist you in shipping your tools, goods, all your needs and even the pets you raise, with residence permits for you and your family, and finding the right schools for your children. Once you are in Turkey, we will help you with everything you need: finding furniture, buying a car, discovering the local amenities and facilities at your place of residence.

Investment Management

We make sure that your investment property works and reap the benefits of your investment. As experienced managers we will have to show you the economic trends of the market, manage your rents, and alert you to the promising opportunities that will earn you the right strategy and time if you want to sell your property.

Our fee for services

We are structuring our services fee according to your specific needs. You are kindly requested to contact us with your needs and demands identified in our services so we can determine our own fees
